text:
alex: hey team — PR #15789 is blocked, CI failing only on linux-smoke-shard-3 after my rebase. locally all tests pass. logs show a KV timeout in the smoke suite. can someone take a quick look or rerun the failing job?

alex: failing snippet:
```
ERROR: Timeout while waiting for kv.get(key) after 30s
  at tests/smoke/test_kv_integration.py:48
  assert value == expected
```

taylor: pinging @sam and @maya — do we know if shard-3 has been noisy this week?

sam: I can rerun the specific build. drop the Buildkite link and I'll trigger a retry of just the smoke job. usually reruns fix these kv flakes.

alex: https://buildkite.redwood.com/builds/3141592 — job name `linux-smoke-shard-3`

maya: quick thought: are you using the shared test bucket? if the kv backend had a transient hiccup, snapshot updates won't help. if it's a real regression, we should see consistent failures across reruns.

karen: FYI we need 2 approvals to merge into main. if rerun passes please @me and I'll give one approval.

sam: starting targeted retry now (using `buildkite-agent`. will re-run the failed step only).

ci-bot: build 3141592: queued rebuild of step linux-smoke-shard-3 by sam.

alex: thanks. I can also run the single test locally in Docker to try to repro: `docker-compose run test pytest tests/smoke/test_kv_integration.py::test_kv_timeout -k kv`

taylor: if it flakes locally too, capture `--showlocals` and the kv server logs, but I suspect this will be transient.

sam: rebuild finished — step passed this time. full smoke suite green on shard-3. :thumbsup:

alex: awesome — looks like transient. I'll hold off on snapshot updates. @karen can you approve when you have a sec?

karen: approving now. merging after a quick green CI sanity check.

alex: merge done. thanks all for the quick help and rerun. noted flaky kv test to track in flaky-tests board.

maya: filing a follow-up ticket to add more retries around kv.get in the smoke harness to reduce these transient failures.

sam: added comment on the ticket with the build link and timestamps for future triage.

ci-bot: merge of PR #15789 by alex completed.
